audit.note: the change handler round-trips the valid flag, the operator and the two toDates dates; on_event applies the filter with follow_up_action( binding_call ) on the table's items

deviations.what: the sap.m.DynamicDateRange control (since UI5 1.92.0) is newer than 1.71 and is the whole point of this sample - kept 1:1, the app needs a UI5 release >= 1.92.0.

the controller's addGroup('Custom', 'Custom Options') and the four custom options it adds to the customOptions aggregation (CustomPreviousXWeekend 'X To Last Weekend', CustomPreviousXWorkWeek 'X To Last Work Week', CustomLastChristmas 'Last Christmas', CustomBusinessDay 'Business Day') are not ported: each is an app-authored DynamicDateOption subclass whose getValueHelpUITypes/format/parse/toDates are JS code, which a thin frontend cannot ship (no app JS modules; a plain DynamicDateOption in the view has no toDates). The DynamicDateRange shows only its standard options.

kept 1:1 with the original: _createFilter's FROM/FROMDATETIME and TO/TODATETIME branches filter the path PerfomDateTime (copied from the sibling sample), which no order row carries, so those operators hide every row - only the BT branch filters orderTime. The port issues the same paths (PERFOMDATETIME / ORDERTIME).

onChange round-trips: the change wire carries ${$parameters>/valid}, ${$parameters>/value/operator} and the two dates of ${$source>}.toDates(value) (the control's own toDates, guarded by a ternary for a cleared value; each Date reaches ABAP as a local ISO timestamp), and the backend applies the controller's _createFilter as follow_up_action( binding_call ) on the orders-table items - FROM/FROMDATETIME as GT, TO/TODATETIME as LT, everything else as BT, an empty value clearing the filter. Rows are filtered on their ISO string, which orders like the original's Date compare. toDates returns sap.ui.core.date.UniversalDate objects, not JS Dates, so each date is sent as .getJSDate() (the second guarded, since FROM/TO yield one date): a bare UniversalDate serialized as {oDate, sCalendarType} and filtered every row away (found by the e2e interaction, 2026-10-20).
the controller's setValueState(ValueState.Error/None) is the bound valueState attribute (value_state, seeded None), set in on_event from the valid parameter.

the controller's _dateFormatter function (DateFormat pattern 'MMMM dd YY, hh:mm:ss') is not an allowed formatter; the ORDERTIME cell keeps the same pattern as a standard sap.ui.model.type.DateTime binding with formatOptions.source over the ISO string the ABAP model holds - same output, the formatter attribute is gone.

the env named model ({env>/filterInputWidth}) is folded into the default model as FILTERINPUTWIDTH, seeded server-side from client->get( )-s_device-system with the original's !Device.system.phone ? '300px' : 'auto' rule.

the mock rows are built in model_init exactly as the controller's aPayments/aOrders: getIcrementedDateFromToday(days, months, years) is reproduced by shifted_now on sy-datum / sy-uzeit (server date and time, not the browser's) with the JS month and day overflow; the fixed UI5Date.getInstance(2021, 5, ...) rows are their ISO literal (month 5 = June). The orders' extra getChristmasDay(currentYear - 1) row is 25 December of the previous year at the current time; the original's setUTCDate (instead of setDate) only differs around midnight UTC. totalPrice is computed in model_init like the original's onInit forEach.

unverified in a running system: the ${$source>}.toDates(${$parameters>/value})[0] event-arg expression with its ternary guard, the Date projection to a local ISO string, and the binding_call filter that follows.
